questions.lead: The S&P 500, August 1987. The month before, the average price rose 2.9%.
questions.ask: How does the monthly average price move this month?
questions.fact: In August 1987 the monthly average price moved +6.2%. Among the other 543 months after a rise in this record (December 1949 on) the moves split: Falls 2% or more 14%; Moves less than 2% either way 47%; Rises 2% or more 40%.
questions.why: A calm month is the most common outcome and a big move either way is rarer, but neither is impossible. Spread the chances the way the record does, then move only for something you know.
